rules: A shared resource has exactly one owner at a time: the serialized foundation named here. Foundations run one after another in the listed order where their paths overlap.

A route or evidence sibling edits only its own route files, focused tests and task-local styles. It does not edit global styles, the gallery registry or a shared adapter; if it needs a change there, that is a finding for the owning foundation.
A compile-only consumer call-signature adjustment outside a foundation's paths is permitted only inside a serialized foundation.
Owners are named by foundation role, from the owner brief's decomposition. The approved graph binds each role to its task; this record does not invent task numbers.
The daily journal is shared by every task: append a unique TASK-ID heading, never rewrite or reorder a peer entry.
No task edits another task's shared file to make a local assertion pass.

foundations.pr287: Supersedes any vendored 0.9.7 package change it carries; the 0.14.3 archive bytes are imported unedited.
Supersedes its card-dialect visuals with the 0.14.3 Card; ports any heading-outline or accessibility fix main lacks.
Supersedes its field visuals; preserves focus-indicator behavior.
Supersedes its shell and per-screen atmosphere visuals; preserves the contained scroller, guards and route set.
Supersedes its dialog and toast geometry; preserves focus trapping, exactly-once callbacks and severity announcements.
Supersedes its 0.9.7 audit prose and visual assertions; none of them is authority over 0.14.3.

routeFamilies.rule: Bounded by route-state-inventory.json: one family per task, its screen files and colocated tests only.
